title: Distributable page list
description: FR-054 / FR-054a. The artefact the project hands to a runner. Self-contained: consumable without the project's data tree, and carrying no ground-truth reference and no ground-truth pixel data. Derived from the internal manifest (Spec 1's manifest.schema.json, FR-001), which it is NOT: the manifest emits gt_root, raw_root and per-page mask_path, all forbidden here.

page_list_identity.description: sha256 over this document's own canonical serialisation with this field omitted, computed by the project. A runner quotes it verbatim into every sidecar's page_list_identity; a runner MUST NOT recompute it by their own method. A result whose quoted identity differs from the current export's is refused (FR-058, research.md R8).

generated_at_run.description: The run_id of the manifest instance this export was derived from.

aligned_size.description: Aligned page size as [width, height]. Every returned mask MUST have exactly this size (FR-058 check 3). 1654x1170 for the current dataset.

alignment.description: The alignment convention every method shares (FR-053c). Raw pages are 1654x1170; ground truth masks are 1656x1176. crop-topleft is lossless by construction because the delta is pad-to-multiple-of-8.

mask_convention.description: The FR-004 prediction-mask convention, restated here so a runner with no access to this repository can produce an admissible mask (FR-042).

image_bundle.description: Where the input images travel and where their identity record lives (FR-054a). The bundle itself is distribution, not contract; the per-page sha256 is the contract.

root.description: Path to the image bundle, relative to the page list. Gitignored (matches the existing *.zip rule); the committed identity record makes any copy verifiable.

identity_record.description: Committed path to the per-page sha256 record, relative to the page list so the pair relocates together. The receipt recomputes each image's hash against this record (FR-058 check 2).

pages.description: Sorted by (manga, stem). The complete set of pages every method runs on; a runner MUST run all of them and MUST NOT add or drop pages.

image_id.description: manga/stem. Preserved verbatim through the whole pipeline (ONBOARDING checklist).

image_ref.description: Relative path to this page's input image inside the bundle. Relative, so the bundle can be relocated.

input_image_identity.description: sha256 of the input image bytes. Quoted verbatim into the sidecar; verified on receipt (FR-054a, FR-058 check 2). The images are the question and the masks are the answer.
